result_text:
I fixed the typos in six default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The scoping and convention tests in `codeanalyzer` pass. I didn't add tests for the new `.htm`, `.js`, `.xml` and `build-gradle.js` matches, so those cases aren't exercised by a test.

- **Generated HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and `<meta name="generator">` rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`. They now read `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match and `.html`/`.xhtml` still do.
- **Generated JS and .NET XML:** the patterns `.*/[.]js` and `.*/[.]xml` became `.*[.]js` and `.*[.]xml`. `app.js` and `MyAssembly.xml` can now match. The content conditions are unchanged (`// Generated by …` on the first line, `<doc>` within the first 2 lines), so hand-written `.js` and `.xml` files stay out.
- **Gradle scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` became `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` lands in build-and-deployment. The `.*[.]gradle` rule that covers `build.gradle` is untouched.

I haven't committed anything.
